blogs.title: Stop Asking AI to Guess: How New Framework Turns LLMs into Feature Engineers
blogs.description: Most current AI tools try to predict answers directly from raw data, which is slow and expensive. This post explains the breakthrough behind FeatLLM, a system that stops using Large Language Models (LLMs) as direct predictors and instead hires them as 'feature engineers.' Learn how this shift allows AI to write custom logic rules for your data once, enabling fast, cheap predictions later without needing constant API calls.

blogs.title: Solving the 'Few-Shot' Puzzle: Making Accurate Predictions with Tiny Datasets
blogs.description: In fields like healthcare or finance, getting thousands of labeled data points is often impossible. This article explores how FeatLLM leverages the vast prior knowledge stored in LLMs to solve 'few-shot' learning problems—making high-accuracy decisions based on just a handful of examples. Discover how combining human-like reasoning with simple math beats traditional machine learning when data is scarce.

blogs.title: Beyond Prompt Limits: How Bagging and Ensembling Fix LLM Constraints for Big Data
blogs.description: One of the biggest hurdles in using AI for spreadsheets is that you can't fit massive tables into an LLM's memory limit. This deep dive looks at the clever technical trick FeatLLM uses: breaking down huge datasets into smaller chunks (bagging) and running multiple rounds of rule generation (ensembling). See how this approach bypasses prompt size limits while actually making the final model more robust against errors.

blogs.title: From Black Box to Clear Logic: Why Rule-Based AI is Better for Business Decisions
blogs.description: Traditional Deep Learning models are often 'black boxes,' making it hard to know why they made a decision. FeatLLM flips the script by forcing the AI to explicitly write out 'if-then' rules before making predictions. This post breaks down how this method creates interpretable, transparent models that business leaders can trust, especially when filtering out noise and irrelevant data columns.
